about: Ascended Health creates effective, all natural organic products that help bodies heal themselves. The products are based on the belief that high vibrational energy imprinted on ingredients help facilitate higher vibrational states. Our products are not engineered or synthetically made. They are novel combinations of well known, but under-utilized botanicals, minerals and herbs. At Ascended Health we always start from scratch by researching the scientific literature and the teachings of indigenous cultures, then improving on what has worked, and making every single item by hand.
intro: Founded by a microbiologist with over 30 years experience researching how indigenous foods and ecology of microflora help stave off disease, detoxify the body, and increase life span. Ascended Health is a trans-denominational, health education and faith-based organization dedicated to creating a unique range of effective, all-natural organic products.

Predicated on the belief that Nature/Universal Source has provided us with everything we need for optimal health, vitality and well-being, Ascended Health specializes in developing effective plant-based extracts into a bio-intelligent format that is eco- harmonic to both the body and spirit through the processing of microbes from longevity zones around the world.

We imbue healing vibrations into our products, and are very conscious of the intentions held at every step of the process of mixing our recipes. From inception, to mixing, to packaging. With the manufacturing of our products, we share a belief in the following simple foundational philosophies:
1. Live life free of unnatural substances, practice healthcare based on natural laws of the universe and connection with traditional Indigenous cultures globally.

2. It is crucial to hold the highest conscious intention at every step of the manufacturing process. We not only place healing intentions into every product, we also incorporate them through sacred geometry in the printing of all product labels.

3. The value and efficacy of infusing every ingredient with scalar vibrational energies from Lemurian quartz crystals, a combination of healing sounds and frequencies from whales, dolphins, sacred chants, prayers, bhajans and meditation during the aging of each batch, a practice which has resulted in numerous favorable reports from customers.

returnPolicy: As of January 17, 2020, we do not accept returns and exchanges on any items offered on ascendedhealth.com

The insurance claim may be denied without the requested images, and in that case a replacement can not be provided. If anything is unclear and you have more questions regarding the return policy, feel free to contact us.
efficacy: No product produced by Ascended Health is made available to the public until we are absolutely convinced of its efficacy and safety and have witnessed positive results in a variety of people. As with all-natural substances, however, it is possible for some people to experience an occasional adverse reaction or sensitivity to an ingredient.

The high-frequency vibrations imbued in each product are designed to support the body's innate inner wisdom, and hence we firmly believe that once you try them, your body's inner guidance system will tell you whether they are an energetic and biological match for you and your health.

intro: At Ascended Health, our mission is shaped by the vision of our founder and formulator, microbiologist Compton Rom, whose work centers on giving the microbes within us the nourishment and consideration they need. We view supplements as a form of concentrated food—carrying information and biological intelligence that guide the body’s natural processes of repair and regeneration. This page serves as our mission statement, outlining the principles and fermentation methods that define our approach to creating living, biologically aligned nourishment.

sections.heading: Biological Intelligence
paragraphs: Biological Intelligence is the natural instruction set found in plants, microbes, and living ecosystems—the language our bodies evolved to understand. Nearly 90% of our cells are microbial, and these microbes instantly recognize compounds shaped by nature, not synthetic processing. Modern supplements often lack this intelligence and therefore offer limited guidance for true regeneration.

At Ascended Health, we restore this conversation by using whole-plant extracts and microbial fermentation to preserve nature’s original signals. Our formulas don’t just deliver nutrients—they reintroduce the biological cues the body needs to repair, rebalance, and thrive.

sections.heading: Food as Information
paragraphs: Food doesn’t just feed the body—it informs it, shaping how cells respond to stress and maintain health. Processed and synthetic foods deliver poor or distorted information, while natural foods carry the Biological Intelligence our cells rely on.

We view our supplements as high-quality “informational food,” crafted in small batches and treated with intention—including prayer and sacred music—to support the subtle and key ways nourishment shapes the body’s healing responses.

sections.heading: The Hidden Majority
paragraphs: Most of the microbes that sustain us live deep in the large intestine, where oxygen cannot reach them—making them extraordinarily difficult to study. Yet these anaerobic “keystone” species are essential for gut integrity, immune regulation, and long-term health.

Ascended Health focuses on nurturing three of the most important: Akkermansia muciniphila, Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, and Christensenella minutae. Many of our formulas are specifically designed to feed, activate, and strengthen this hidden microbial majority.

sections.heading: Bioavailability of our products
paragraphs: Your gut is the most densely populated ecosystem on earth, with ten layers of microbes forming a barrier between your food and your own cells. These microbes get the first “bite” of everything you eat—and immediately begin fermenting it into more usable forms.

At Ascended Health, by fermenting our plant extracts outside the body first, through a natural pre-digestion process, we spare the gut unnecessary work and enhance nutrient availability. This ensures our formulas feed both you and your microbes for more complete, efficient nourishment.

sections.heading: Muti-stage Cascade Fermentation
paragraphs: Just as the microbiome works in layered synergy, our formulations are created through a proprietary multi-stage fermentation process. Each stage builds on the last, mirroring the complexity of the gut and dramatically enhancing the vitality and potency of the final product.

sections.heading: Biophotonic Fermentation
paragraphs: We reconnect fermentation to nature by burying our cultures in black soil and compost, exposing them to the biophotonic light and biological signals emitted by living soil ecosystems. This infuses our quartz-glass vessels with natural intelligence.
Most commercial ferments are isolated in stainless-steel vats, disconnected from earth’s resonance—resulting in products that lack the vibrancy we consider essential.

sections.heading: Sourcing from Longevity Zones
paragraphs: Our microbial starters come directly from regions where people routinely live past 100—Ikaria, Costa Rica, Japan, and the Kamchatka Peninsula. From their fermented foods and root vegetables, we collect wild, naturally resilient strains of Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium, Streptococcus, and Saccharomyces.

These microbes have not been weakened by repeated lab propagation; they are shaped by real environments and daily stressors. If they help nourish long-lived communities, we believe they can help support yours as well.

sections.heading: Scalar-based Vibrational Frequency Imprinting
paragraphs: We also integrate subtle-energy elements into our formulations through carefully selected mineral and crystalline components. These materials are known for their stable vibrational properties, which help support the energetic coherence of each product. In this way, while our fermentation methods maximize biological effectiveness, every formula is also crafted with a deeper intention—to create products that nourish on both the physical and subtle levels.

changes.heading: CHANGES IN FLAVORS, TEXTURE AND TASTE
paragraphs: Don’t be surprised to have an inconsistent product from Ascended Health from time to time. On the contrary, welcome it! Even though we use the same recipe each time, no batch is ever exactly the same. We follow nature’s laws closely. In the wild, you see variation, not consistency. By keeping each batch different, pathogenic microbes are kept guessing. We believe that harmful microbes have a harder time adapting and becoming resistant later if given a different concentration of oils from one batch to the next. Not to mention, that everything is hand produced. We do not believe in automation.

Friendly microbes play a big role in our products. In addition to variation of our hand made products, when healthy microbes bio-activate, the consistency, texture and flavor change. Additionally, we are selective about where our minerals are sourced and occasionally will shift. Our Earth is in continuous change and we only use products from Earth, no synthetics. We honor Mother Nature and our products reflect that intention.

shipping.heading: SHIPPING NOTICE
paragraphs: Our products are hand made in small batches. Between that and high demand, delays of 2-3 days may be experienced in shipping. Most packages are shipped within 2 business days of an order. We do our best to accommodate all orders as quickly as possible.

If you choose EXPRESS SHIPPING, this is the method and speed of shipment after our shipping department receives your order. There is an automatic 24-hour delay due to order processing, and there may be an additional delay due to lack of inventory.
